title: Duskmourn: House of Horror Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane that is a labyrinthine House of horrors, where time moves strangely and survivors wander.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demonic ruler of Duskmourn, worshipped by devotees and a source of whispers and fear; he sheds his old form in events called Harrowings.

entities.name: Harrowing
entities.description: A malevolent wave that courses through the House whenever Valgavoth sheds his old form, spawning new horrors.

entities.name: Hauntwoods
entities.description: A part of Duskmourn through which a Demolisher Spawn rips.

entities.name: Floodpits
entities.description: A part of Duskmourn with bizarre aquatic creatures.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A burning chasm in which ancient evils dwell.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Monstrous inhabitants of Duskmourn, for whom painless dissolution is a worse fate than agonizing death.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A survivor in Duskmourn who warns of razorkin passages.

entities.name: Meg
entities.description: A supply runner.

events.summary: Time warps in Duskmourn; terrors of the past and torments of the present stretch on.
Each time Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing sweeps the House spawning new horrors.
events.quote: Whenever Valgavoth sheds his old form, a Harrowing courses through the House

events.summary: Julie is trapped in a doll and then suffers a worse fate.
events.quote: Julie thought getting trapped in a doll was the worst fate imaginable.

events.summary: Irene screams in denial as a Cackling Counterpart laughs.
events.quote: Irene's screams of denial harmonized with its terrible laughter.

events.summary: Asha leaves Bant after ensuring the world has protection and order.
events.quote: When Asha left Bant, she ensured that the world would have protection and order in her absence.

events.summary: Angrath calls dinosaurs dragons and the name sticks among pirates.
events.quote: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

events.summary: Emrakul's influence radiates across Innistrad, making evacuation from Kessig's villages difficult.
events.quote: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad

events.summary: The sylex blast ends the war.
events.quote: The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war
